news.summary: Benzinga highlighted analysts fine-tuning estimates ahead of the September 21 H1 2026 report, with consensus pointing to a per-share loss near $1.08 and negligible revenue. The piece framed the print as a key checkpoint on cash runway and NDA-readiness spending.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $101
news.summary: Morgan Stanley reiterated an Overweight rating on Abivax while lifting its price target, citing improved odds of success for obefazimod in the Crohn's disease indication following management discussions.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Abivax at Buy, Sees Obefazimod as 'Multiblockbuster'
news.summary: Goldman Sachs started coverage with a Buy rating and a $155 price target, calling obefazimod's oral, biologic-like efficacy profile in ulcerative colitis a multiblockbuster opportunity while flagging Abivax as a plausible M&A target even as self-commercialization looks viable post-financing.

news.headline: The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?
news.summary: STAT examined why Abivax remains independent despite months of Big Pharma takeover speculation (including earlier Eli Lilly interest), noting the company's $920M July raise gives it leverage to pursue a solo US launch rather than accept a lowball offer.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax confirmed a successful pre-NDA meeting with the FDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, reaffirming the company remains on track to submit its first NDA by the end of 2026.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Confirmed on the company's financial calendar; not yet released as of this research (checked evening of Sept 21). Will update cash position/runway (last reported ~€492M at Q1 2026), R&D spend, and any commentary on NDA submission timing, Crohn's pipeline progress, and M&A posture.

catalysts.label: Obefazimod NDA submission to FDA (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Company has repeatedly reaffirmed, most recently via the positive July 30 pre-NDA FDA meeting, plans to submit the first NDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis by year-end 2026.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease induction readout
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in Crohn's disease is expected mid-2027; Morgan Stanley recently raised its odds-of-success view for this indication.

catalysts.label: Potential M&A / takeover of Abivax
catalysts.detail: Persistent speculation continues (prior reports of Eli Lilly interest, denied January 2026; earlier AstraZeneca interest, denied March 2026). Management says the $920M July raise supports a standalone US launch path, reducing near-term deal pressure, though Goldman Sachs still flags Abivax as a plausible acquisition target.

pulse: Abivax remains in a holding pattern heading into its H1 2026 results, due after today's US market close but not yet published as of this research — consensus points to a continued cash-burn quarter with focus on runway confirmation and any fresh NDA-timeline or M&A commentary. Sell-side sentiment has turned increasingly bullish into the print (Goldman Sachs Buy/$155 PT, Morgan Stanley price-target raise), with the positive July FDA pre-NDA meeting and a well-funded balance sheet underpinning confidence in the planned late-Q4 2026 NDA filing. Takeover speculation persists but remains unconfirmed, with management signaling readiness to launch obefazimod independently in the US if no deal materializes.
